inputs.edit_region: control-grid [x,y,w,h] expanded around the changed control component
inputs.source_control: predicted control before the typed operation
inputs.edited_control: predicted control after the typed operation

prohibitions: Do not use target labels to select or modify the operation.
Do not count an abstention as a semantic success.
Do not open the test split before the model and thresholds are frozen.
Do not pool operation success with Room IoU or graph quality.
Do not treat direct family deletion as evidence of target-relative correctness.

room_type.source_class: room class with the largest negative control-logit delta in the edit region
room_type.target_class: room class with the largest positive control-logit delta in the edit region
room_type.success: The edit changes pixels, at least 50% of changed pixels use the requested target class, and at least 4 output pixels use the target class.

room_add.source_class: room class with the largest negative control-logit delta in the edit region
room_add.target_class: room class with the largest positive control-logit delta in the edit region
room_add.success: The edit changes pixels, at least 50% of changed pixels use the requested target class, and the target class has at least 4 output pixels.

room_remove.source_class: room class with the largest negative control-logit delta in the edit region, falling back to the dominant pre-edit room class inside the region
room_remove.success: The edit changes pixels, at least 50% of source-class pixels are removed, and another room class remains after the merge.

opening_delete.success: At least one opening pixel exists before and zero opening-family pixels remain inside the edit region.

furniture_delete.success: At least one furniture pixel exists before and zero furniture-family pixels remain inside the edit region.
